map.由预期股利、要求收益率与增长率求股价 使用指南: Share Price from Expected Dividend, Required Return and Growth Rate User Guide
map.输入预期每股股利 D₁、要求收益率 r 与股利增长率 g，求合理股价。: Enter expected dividend per share D1, required return r and dividend growth rate g to find the fair share price.
map.稳定增长股的内在价值估算（P=D₁/(r−g)）。: Intrinsic value estimation of a stable-growth stock (P = D1/(r-g)).
map.与 DDM 等价，常用于股息贴现教学与估值。: It is equivalent to the DDM and is commonly used in dividend discount teaching and valuation.
map.敏感性分析：r 与 g 的微小变动对价格影响极大。: Sensitivity analysis: small changes in r and g have a very large effect on price.
map.：P = 2.1/(0.10−0.05) = 42 元。若 r 升到 11%：P: : P = 2.1/(0.10 - 0.05) = 42 CNY. If r rises to 11%: P = 2.1/(0.11 - 0.05) = 35 CNY, one notch of spread cuts the price by 17%.
map.：D₁=2.1, r=10%, g=3%：P=2.1/(0.07)=30 元。增: : D1 = 2.1, r = 10%, g = 3%: P = 2.1/(0.07) = 30 CNY. Lower growth gives a lower valuation.
map.由买卖价与股息求持有期收益率: Holding period return from buy/sell price and dividends
map.由主动收益序列求信息比率: Information ratio from a sequence of active returns
map.由账户权益与持仓市值求保证金比例: Margin ratio from account equity and position market value
map.股价 × 总股本: Share price x total shares outstanding
map.和 DDM 有何不同？: How does it differ from the DDM?
map.Gordon 增长模型就是单阶段 DDM，公式完全一致，名称不同而已。: The Gordon growth model is the single-stage DDM; the formula is identical, only the name differs.
map.不能，否则分母为负/零，估值无界。现实中 g 长期不超过名义 GDP 增速。: No, otherwise the denominator is negative or zero and the valuation is unbounded. In reality g does not exceed nominal GDP growth over the long run.
